title: Meow stats
description: A plain title over a bento of figures: one tall ink-dark card on the left with a huge 120px figure sitting at its foot, two white hairline-boxed cards stacked on the right with 56px figures; each figure has a short rule and a one-line label under it. Stacked on phones.
notes: the first stat becomes the dark card (theme's dark tokens, class `dark`); the next two are the outlined ones
